entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes... I need some help. I ordered a jersey and I'm just so confused by the whole process. I looked on your website and couldn't figure it out.

I can certainly help you with that. I'm pulling up your account now. I see you recently purchased the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. I think I just ordered the wrong size. It feels really too tight across the chest. I want to get a new one, but the website was confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you with an exchange. It sounds like a simple size swap is all you need. Let me just check the policy for you.
Okay, thank you. I was worried it was going to be a problem.
Not at all. I can see you received the jersey just 9 days ago. For standard items like this, you are well within our 90-day return and exchange window. We can definitely get you the right size.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief! I was so stressed about it. Yes, an exchange would be wonderful.

Excellent. I'm processing that for you now. I will email you a pre-paid return label for the jersey that's too tight. As soon as you send that back, we'll ship out the next size up. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
